messages:
felix: quick probe 00m: proposing a tiny loader-ABI manifest so runtime and loader can negotiate capabilities before streaming shards (avoid trial-and-error fallbacks). thoughts?

ameerah: +1. high level: manifest in catalog vs embedded in checkpoint? and what would be the minimal fields?

felix: minimal: format, abi_version, loader_min_version, capability_flags, shard_layout, and a compact compat_matrix for quant profiles. manifest is a small immutable JSON blob referenced by commit (e.g. manifest_key). runtime fetches it first.

jorge: cacheability is important. runtime shouldn't parse manifest for every request. cache by model-id + abi_version; evict when manifest signature changes.

ameerah: also include "required_runtime_flags" so ingest can express hard requirements (eg "supports_runtime_dequant"). if runtime lacks flags we should fail fast (412) and route to derivation service instead.

felix: example manifest snippet (informal): {"format":"safetensors","abi_version":"1.2","loader_min_version":"2.0.0","capabilities":["per-tensor-checksums","chunked-gcm","index-sidecar"],"compatibility":{"quant_profiles":["q8_0","q4_1"]}}

jorge: semver policy: runtime must accept older abi_version if it has superset capabilities; but manifest.loader_min_version will gate breaking changes. define exact comparison rules in RFC.

ameerah: security: sign manifest with KMS and include a signature blob in commit metadata. runtime validates signature and caches public key. also surface manifest schema version in metadata.

felix: operational: ingest generates manifest during staging; build pipeline ensures loader_min_version bumped if we introduce breaking ABI changes. runtime to return 412 when runtime_version < loader_min_version. we also expose a manifest-cache invalidation endpoint for emergency rollbacks.

build-bot: manifest registered: chkpt_manifest_zz1 by felix at 2026-05-02T12:03:21Z :white_check_mark:

jorge: LGTM. small nit: client libs should include a helper to negotiate capabilities and fall back to derivation or older checkpoints gracefully.

felix: good call. I'll add a lightweight negotiation helper to devex and draft the manifest schema in the RFC. thanks everyone!
